headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 10, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox fell short in Toronto, while the New York Mets secured an 8-5 victory over the Atlanta Braves. The Minnesota Twins took down the Baltimore Orioles 9-5, and the Philadelphia Phillies edged the St. Louis Cardinals in a thrilling 6-5 win.

Top MLB news saw Charles McAdoo lead the Red Sox offense with a home run and an RBI, while Jameson Taillon pitched 4.0 strong innings for the Red Sox. Brett Baty led the Mets at the plate with a home run and four RBIs, and Brent Suter pitched 3.0 strong innings with three strikeouts and no earned runs. Josh Bell led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs, while Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture. Other players on the injured list include Tyler Freeman of the Colorado Rockies, Nathan Eovaldi of the Texas Rangers, Shaun Anderson of the Los Angeles Angels, Devin Williams of the New York Mets, Caleb Kilian of the Philadelphia Phillies, Griffin Jax of the Tampa Bay Rays, and Cooper Pratt of the Milwaukee Brewers.

The Kansas City Royals have added first baseman Jacob Berry to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the Red Sox offense going 1-for-2 with a home run and an RBI. Jameson Taillon pitched 4.0 strong innings for the Red Sox, striking out 3 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves 8-5**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the team at the plate. Baty hit a home run and drove in four runs, while Brent Suter pitched 3.0 strong innings with three strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win. Jonathan Bowlan closed out the game with a save.

top_news.title: **Giants C Daniel Susac Lands on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have added first baseman Jacob Berry to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being dealt to the team.
